name: Zigbee2MQTT
short_description: Bridge Zigbee devices to MQTT without proprietary hubs.
description: Zigbee2MQTT bridges your Zigbee devices to MQTT, allowing them to work with any home automation platform without vendor lock-in. Supports 3000+ Zigbee devices from brands like Philips Hue, IKEA, Aqara, and more. Requires a Zigbee USB coordinator.
usecases: Connect Zigbee sensors, bulbs, and switches directly to MQTT.
Integrate hundreds of Zigbee devices with Home Assistant via MQTT.
Eliminate cloud dependency for Zigbee smart home devices.
notes: A Zigbee USB coordinator (e.g., ConBee II, CC2652) must be attached to the host.
Configure the coordinator USB path in /app/data/configuration.yaml after install.
